en-US.description: Set up and send queries to the relevant cube and to analyze the data returned.
en-US.longDescription: Cube Browser is used to set up and send queries to the relevant cube and to analyze the data returned. Cube Browser communicates with cubes on Rystad Energy's servers via the Internet using proprietary encryption. Data is not stored on the user’s computer unless the user exports tables, charts or maps to other documents. Set-up files and data structure files are stored on the user's PC in a folder not requiring administrator rights. The users download and install a client/front-end software, Cube Browser, on their PC.
en-US.name: Cube Browser

zh-CN.description: 配置并向相关 cube 发送查询请求，同时分析返回的数据。
zh-CN.longDescription: Cube Browser 用于配置并向相关 cube 发送查询请求，同时分析返回的数据。该工具通过专有加密技术与 Rystad Energy 服务器上的 cubes 进行互联网通信。除非用户主动将表格、图表或地图导出至其他文档，否则数据不会存储在用户本地计算机上。配置文件和数据结构文件存储在用户 PC 的非管理员权限目录中。用户需下载并安装客户端/前端软件 Cube Browser 至个人电脑。
